requirement_text:
Requirements

As an user, I would like to modify the application process and add additional field in the 'Education & Remarks' & Certification sections

A new file upload control should be available and user should be able to choose and upload file.

* users are able to choose and upload their educational documents and the certificate documents
* A new table should be added to the database named "FileUploads"
* My goal is the FileUpload table is open for all modules. 
* EntityId should be ApplicationId and EntityTypeId should be EducationId 
* EntityId should be ApplicationId and EntityTypeId should be CertificationId
* Create a new folder namm=ed "FIleUploads" in the application directory and save the path in FileUploads table. 

Check

* Only specified changes has to be made
* Existing functionalities should not get affected
* File Upload should be working fine.
* Ensure file upload code changes are fine below areas
-> SQL DB
-> Migration applied correctly
-> Server side code changes
-> viewmodel.js changes
-> .cshtml controls are fine
-> Ensure nothing is breaking

requirements.text: Add a new file upload control in the application process allowing users to select and upload educational and certificate documents.
Create a new database table named FileUploads with appropriate entity fields to support document uploads across modules.
Set specific EntityId and EntityTypeId mapping rules for certification and education uploaded documents.
Create a FileUploads directory in the application file system and store the file paths in the FileUploads table.
Ensure file upload functionality works correctly across database migrations, server-side logic, view models, and Razor CSHTML views without affecting existing features.

tasks.name: Implement FileUpload entity model, DbContext mapping, database migration, and storage directory initialization
Add document upload controls to Application Wizard Razor View and Knockout ViewModel
Implement server-side document persistence and FileUpload record generation in Workflow Service
